skill.name: form-cro
skill.description: Optimize non-signup forms such as lead capture, contact, demo request, application, survey, quote, and checkout forms.
skill.summary: Audits non-signup forms and recommends conversion-focused improvements to fields, layout, copy, validation, and testing.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.value_statement: Forms often lose qualified visitors through excess fields, unclear copy, and weak error handling. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code audit forms and recommend field, layout, copy, trust, and testing improvements.
actual_capabilities: Audits field count, field order, required fields, and optional fields.
Recommends clearer labels, placeholders, help text, and submit button copy.
Advises on single-step, multi-step, and progressive commitment form structures.
Reviews inline validation, error messages, mobile usability, and post-submit states.
Suggests trust elements, measurement plans, and A/B test hypotheses for form changes.
Provides guidance for lead capture, contact, demo request, quote, survey, and checkout forms.
limitations: It does not implement frontend code or modify production forms directly.
It needs form details, screenshots, analytics, or field data for precise recommendations.
It is not intended for signup flows or popup forms with separate specialist skills.
Conversion impact estimates require testing before they should be treated as proven results.

use_cases.title: Improve Lead Capture Forms
use_cases.description: Reduce unnecessary fields and clarify the value exchange for gated content or newsletter forms.

use_cases.title: Redesign Complex Request Forms
use_cases.description: Break long quote, application, or survey forms into clearer steps with better field sequencing.

use_cases.title: Increase Demo Request Quality
use_cases.description: Balance sales qualification needs with lower friction for prospects who request a demo.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Form Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for a known form.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this contact form for conversion issues. The fields are name, email, phone, company, message, and budget. Recommend the highest-impact fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Field Reduction Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for simplifying a form.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this lead capture form and decide which fields should be required, optional, removed, or asked after submission. Explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Mobile Form Redesign
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this five-field demo request form for mobile completion. Include field order, labels, validation behavior, button copy, and trust messaging.

prompt_templates.title: Experiment Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an A/B testing plan for this form using completion rate, field drop-off, error rate, and mobile versus desktop data. Prioritize three experiments.

output_examples.input: A demo request form requires name, email, phone, company size, budget, and message.
output_examples.output: High priority: make phone optional, move budget later, and change the button to Request a demo. Test shorter qualification first.

output_examples.input: A checkout form has many validation errors on mobile.
output_examples.output: Recommended changes include larger tap targets, field-specific keyboards, inline validation after blur, and error messages placed beside each field.

output_examples.input: A gated content form asks for seven fields before download.
output_examples.output: Start with email only or email plus name. Ask enrichment questions after the download when user motivation is higher.

best_practices: Provide current fields, completion rate, device split, and known drop-off points when available.
Ask for recommendations by priority so design, copy, and analytics changes are easy to sequence.
Validate suggested changes with A/B tests or field-level analytics before making permanent decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to optimize signup or registration flows covered by another specialist skill.
Do not treat conversion estimates as guaranteed outcomes without testing.
Do not remove legally required fields only to reduce friction.

faq.question: What types of forms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports lead capture, contact, demo request, application, survey, quote, checkout, and similar non-signup forms.

faq.question: Can it help choose which fields to remove?
faq.answer: Yes. It evaluates each field against user effort, business need, follow-up value, and timing.

faq.question: Does it write production form code?
faq.answer: No. It provides UX, copy, layout, validation, measurement, and testing recommendations.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the form type, current fields, completion rate, device split, drop-off data, and business requirements.

faq.question: Can it improve mobile forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers tap targets, keyboard types, single-column layout, autofill, sticky submit buttons, and minimal typing.

faq.question: Is it suitable for signup forms?
faq.answer: No. Signup and registration flows should use a dedicated signup-flow CRO skill.
